implementations.implementation-1.json: Original three feature additions plus the first blocker fixes (coverage book/chapter, primary-source discovery, independent evidence review).
implementations.implementation-2.json: Adds the source-download timeout classification and the bounded reviewer retry; the evidence rules audited in packets-sol-audit-3.json.
implementations.implementation-3.json: Evidence packets carry no model-ordered sequence (order only inside individually supported claims), unknowns are never about provenance, the repair is built against the reviewer's corrected episode, a claim rejected on the final review is excised (floor two), reviewer fields tolerate null; developBookPlan sets the stance thesis from the developed answer instead of comparing strings.
implementations.implementation-4.json: implementation-3 plus: a case is grounded by at least one anchor resolving to exact passage text; extra anchors that do not resolve are ignored instead of failing the packet.
implementations.implementation-5.json: implementation-4 plus: a chapter with no case is a defect only when it names no prerequisite; a synthesis chapter inherits its prerequisites' packets and is told to introduce no new case; three development attempts; unresolved model-review objections stored as bookDevelopment.reviewNotes (logged, shown to the developmental edit) instead of failing the book; prompts accept honestly scoped coverage and exclude the voice sample from evidence.
implementations.implementation-6.json: implementation-5 plus: reviewChapterCaseEvidence returns { issues, dropped } with one verbatim re-quote request; repairChapterEvidence runs at most two targeted edits and never throws; residual findings stored on the chapter report, logged, and turned into a compile-time UNSUPPORTED_CASE_CLAIMS error issue (REVIEW_REQUIRED) by unsupportedCaseClaimIssues; finalize and developmental edit take the same door; peer's pipelineStages/textRouting purpose-list edits included.
implementations.implementation-6a.json: implementation-6 plus (Opus-panel session, 07:04 UTC): generateJsonWithRetry buys one more attempt at 1.5x maxTokens when the provider reports the reply was cut at max_output_tokens (isOutputBudgetExhausted), outside the repair count; poppler-utils added to the Dockerfile so pdftotext exists in the worker image (every PDF source fetch had failed with 'spawn pdftotext ENOENT'; takes effect at the next image build).
implementations.implementation-6b.json: implementation-6a plus (Opus-panel session, 08:08 UTC): the developmental edit's book-level length gate no longer fails the job; when the edited manuscript is under its word floor, the chapters furthest under their own budget (at most six) are developed by the line editor's extension mode on their material and re-checked against their evidence (extendUnderBudget), and any remaining shortfall is recorded on the developmentalEdit marker and logged as generation.composed_chapters.length_shortfall. Over the maximum still fails. Worker typecheck and the developmental-edit tests (10) pass.

evidenceReplays.evidence-replay-4.json: candidate-evidence-rules.json injected at the adapter boundary; 8/8 expected decisions; audited as packets-sol-audit-3.json (K1, K7 unusable).
evidenceReplays.evidence-replay-5.json: candidate-evidence-rules-2.json injected at the adapter boundary with sequence forced empty; 7/8 (Socrates lost to one overclaimed claim the repair did not fix), K1/K7 defects absent by construction.
evidenceReplays.evidence-replay-6.json: production modules of implementation-3, no injection: 7/8 (both wrong cases rejected; K1 First Crusade and K7 Josephus rebuilt without a sequence; Keeley lost on a protocol defect — a second reviewer anchor broken by an OCR running header/soft hyphen while the first resolved exactly). Fixed in implementation-4 by requiring one resolving anchor rather than all.
